packageRules.description: Majors are merged by a human.
A 0.x release conveys breaking changes in its minor, which Renovate still classifies as `minor`. The group above already excludes 0.x; this covers the individual PRs it leaves behind.

Compiled addons, the at-rest/wire encoders, and the SQL engine are merged by a human, and get their own PR rather than riding in a group. Keep this list and the exclusions above in step: a name in only one of them either rides the group while blocking the group's automerge, or is silently automergeable.

rocksdb-js is proposed by .github/workflows/update-rocksdb-js.yml on every upstream release. Renovate would open a second PR for the same bump, and that workflow's cleanup only closes PRs on its own head branch.
